title: A match score versus a sentence
summary: Which fusion design scores a pair, and which one answers in text.

choices.text: Product 1: a vision encoder plus a projector into an LLM (early fusion), since the projector is trained as a similarity. Product 2: CLIP with a text decoder that reads its image embedding.
Product 1: a contrastive dual encoder such as CLIP or SigLIP (late fusion). Product 2: a vision encoder plus a projector into an LLM, as in LLaVA (early fusion).
Product 1: LLaVA, scoring the caption by its log-likelihood under the language model (early fusion). Product 2: SigLIP, whose text tower decodes the answer word by word.
Product 1: a contrastive dual encoder such as CLIP (late fusion). Product 2: Flamingo-style cross-attention, which is early fusion because the visual features enter the LLM's input sequence.
